projects.official_name: AI IoT Dual Compartment Medicine Dispenser
projects.purpose: Demonstrates automated healthcare adherence using localized IoT networks, electronic scheduling, and real-time kinetic impact confirmation.
projects.what_it_does: Allows users to schedule prescriptions via a web dashboard and automatically dispenses precise tablet quantities sequentially from distinct chutes.

how_it_works.processing: The ESP32 tracks real-time scheduling milestones against dashboard entries, activating precise motor speeds sequentially and monitoring analog vibration spikes to verify successful physical tablet drop confirmation.

visitor_interaction.how_visitor_starts: The visitor accesses the local IP address on a web browser to view the unified configuration dashboard interface.
visitor_actions: Connects smartphone to the local device network hotspot
Enters desired delivery hours and minutes via dashboard
Modifies target tablet counts for separate compartments
Adjusts motor drive speed and sensor sensitivity parameters
Triggers manual testing button for local deployment validation
system_response: Updates operational scheduling memory variables instantaneously
Fires audible buzzer alarms when milestone schedules match
Drives specific compartment gear motors to release pills
Processes analog vibration spikes during dropping phases
Appends precise delivery success timestamps to history tables
visitor_interaction.completion: The visitor receives their tablet and reviews the validated completion log update on the web app.

projects.official_name: AI Smart Crowd Counter and Person Tracking
projects.purpose: Demonstrates real-time AI person detection and tracking to count and log crowd occupancy using a live camera feed.
projects.what_it_does: Detects people from a live camera, assigns unique IDs, tracks entry/exit times, and displays stats on a dashboard.

inputs: IP camera URL entered by user
how_it_works.processing: YOLOv8 detects people, ByteTrack assigns persistent IDs, tracks movement, logs entry/exit times to SQLite database.
outputs: Live video feed with bounding boxes
Person ID labels on each person

visitor_interaction.how_visitor_starts: Visitor opens the website URL in a browser and enters the IP camera URL.
visitor_actions: Enter the IP camera URL into the input box
Click Connect to start the live stream
View detected people on the live feed
Search for a person by ID
Export attendance data as CSV
Toggle dark mode
system_response: Displays live video with bounding boxes and IDs
Shows real-time person count and FPS
Updates people table every second
Shows entry time, exit time, and duration
Highlights new entries and exits
visitor_interaction.completion: Visitor can stop by closing the browser tab or disconnecting the camera.

visible_features: Live camera feed with bounding boxes
Person IDs above each detected person

projects.purpose: Demonstrates an AI-based recruitment platform that evaluates candidates through skill and job-specific assessments.
projects.what_it_does: Evaluates candidate skills, conducts job assessments, recommends suitable jobs, and provides performance feedback.

how_it_works.processing: The system verifies the candidate, displays skill and job-specific questions, evaluates responses, calculates scores, and recommends suitable jobs based on performance.

visitor_interaction.how_visitor_starts: The visitor logs in using Candidate ID and password.
visitor_actions: Login to system
Enter candidate details
Complete skill tests
Choose job role
Answer job questions
View final result
system_response: Displays skill assessment
Starts countdown timer
Shows job questions
Evaluates answers
Calculates scores
Displays final result
visitor_interaction.completion: The visitor views the final assessment result and recommended job outcome.

projects.purpose: Demonstrates real-time AI-powered American Sign Language recognition entirely in the browser, showing visitors how machine learning can bridge communication gaps.
projects.what_it_does: Recognizes 10 ASL hand signs from a webcam feed in real time, displays the corresponding letter on screen, and optionally speaks it aloud.

how_it_works.processing: MediaPipe AI detects the hand and extracts 21 landmark points. A TensorFlow.js neural network classifies the landmark pattern into one of 10 trained ASL letters using an 8-frame smoothing window.

visitor_interaction.how_visitor_starts: Click the Start Experience button on the welcome screen and allow camera access when the browser prompts.
visitor_actions: Allow camera access when browser requests permission
Choose between Interpret mode or Learn mode using the toggle
Hold up hand and form one of the 10 ASL letter shapes
Hold the sign steady for about half a second for recognition
In Interpret mode, build a sentence letter by letter
In Learn mode, follow prompts to practice each sign
system_response: Displays detected hand skeleton overlay on camera feed
Shows recognized letter with confidence percentage
Commits letter to sentence after 500ms hold
Speaks recognized letters or full sentence aloud
Provides correct or wrong feedback in Learn mode
Cycles through all 10 signs for practice in Learn mode
visitor_interaction.completion: The interaction has no fixed end. Visitors can stop anytime by closing the tab or switching modes to try a different experience.

visible_features: Live camera feed with hand skeleton overlay
Large letter display card with glow animation
Interpret and Learn mode toggle switch
How It Works five-step pipeline explanation
Idle attract mode with ASL facts

projects.purpose: Collects visitor voice feedback and generates AI-powered feedback reports for museum administrators.
projects.what_it_does: Records visitor speech, converts it to text, and uses an LLM to create a structured feedback report.

how_it_works.processing: Captures visitor audio, converts speech to text, sends the transcript to an LLM, and generates a structured feedback report.

visitor_interaction.how_visitor_starts: Visitor approaches the microphone and shares their feedback.
visitor_actions: Speak into microphone
Share exhibit experience
Finish speaking
system_response: Records voice
Transcribes speech
Generates AI report
visitor_interaction.completion: Recording is processed and the feedback report is generated.

projects.purpose: Demonstrates real-time hand gesture recognition in the browser using MediaPipe, making AI interaction tangible and playful through a puzzle game.
projects.what_it_does: Lets visitors use hand gestures to capture a live webcam photo and solve a shuffled 3×3 sliding puzzle with their fingers.

how_it_works.processing: MediaPipe Hands tracks 21 hand landmarks in real time via WebAssembly. A pinch gesture draws a square crop from the video feed. Dwell detection picks up and swaps 3×3 puzzle tiles. All logic runs client-side with no server.

visitor_interaction.how_visitor_starts: Visitor enters their name and department, then clicks Start Camera to enable the webcam.
visitor_actions: Enter name and department on the start screen.
Click Start Camera and allow webcam access.
Pinch thumb and index finger to draw a square selection on the live video.
Release pinch to confirm the captured region.
Click Make Puzzle to shuffle and start the puzzle.
Use finger dwell or mouse drag to rearrange tiles into correct order.
system_response: Webcam feed appears with hand tracking overlay active.
A square selection box follows the pinch gesture in real time.
A preview of the captured crop is shown for confirmation.
Nine tiles are sliced from the image, shuffled, and displayed.
A dwell progress ring appears when finger hovers over a tile.
Timer stops and leaderboard appears when puzzle is solved; confetti fires for new record.
visitor_interaction.completion: The visitor knows it is finished when the Solved! overlay appears, the timer stops, and the leaderboard is shown.

projects.purpose: Greet museum visitors autonomously, recognize VIPs, and answer questions about AI exhibits via voice interaction.
projects.what_it_does: Patrols a museum hall autonomously, greets visitors by name, answers exhibit questions through speech, and avoids obstacles.

how_it_works.processing: Runs concurrent threads for navigation, obstacle avoidance, face recognition, and voice pipeline (STT via faster-whisper, Q&A via Ollama llama3.2, TTS via Coqui XTTS-v2). Position fused from dead-reckoning and ORB visual relocalization.

visitor_interaction.how_visitor_starts: Robot patrols autonomously; visitor walks near it or says the wake phrase 'Hey Robot'.
visitor_actions: Approach the robot in the museum hall
Say 'Hey Robot' to activate voice Q&A
Ask a question about exhibits or the museum
Wait for the robot's spoken answer
Say 'Thank you' or 'Goodbye' to end conversation
system_response: Detects face and recognizes VIPs from database
Greets known visitors by name with a handshake gesture
Listens via microphone with voice activity detection
Transcribes speech and queries Ollama LLM
Speaks answer while bobbing head for lip-sync effect
Resumes autonomous patrol after interaction ends
visitor_interaction.completion: Robot returns to patrolling waypoints after answering or silence timeout (30s).

projects.official_name: Precision Agriculture Copilot for Crop Health, Yield & Advisory
projects.purpose: Provides an AI agriculture assistant for crop-related questions and plant disease detection.
projects.what_it_does: Answers agriculture questions and analyzes uploaded plant images to identify possible diseases, confidence, description, treatment, prevention, and related products.

how_it_works.processing: Uses Google Gemma 4 E2B with an agriculture LoRA adapter for question answering and EfficientNet-B0 for plant disease classification.

visitor_interaction.how_visitor_starts: Visitor opens the Agriculture AI Assistant webpage.
visitor_actions: Enter an agriculture question
Click Ask Agriculture AI
Upload a plant image
Click Detect Disease
system_response: Displays the agriculture AI answer
Analyzes the plant image
Displays disease prediction and confidence
Displays treatment and prevention information
visitor_interaction.completion: Interaction is complete when the visitor receives an agriculture answer or a plant disease analysis result.

projects.official_name: Deepfake & Synthetic-Media Detection for Enterprise Security
projects.purpose: Detects whether an uploaded image is a real camera image or an AI-generated image.
projects.what_it_does: Accepts an uploaded image, detects a face, classifies the image as human or artificial, and displays prediction confidence.

how_it_works.processing: Uses OpenCV Haar Cascade face detection and the Smogy/SMOGY-Ai-images-detector Vision Transformer model.

visitor_interaction.how_visitor_starts: Visitor opens the local Streamlit application.
visitor_actions: Upload an image
View the uploaded image
Review the detection result
system_response: Displays the uploaded image
Detects a face
Classifies the image
Displays the result and confidence score
visitor_interaction.completion: Interaction is complete when the visitor receives the image classification result and confidence score.

projects.purpose: Analyzes legal contracts, identifies potentially risky clauses, and provides reference-based insights using LLMs, retrieval-augmented generation, and a legal clause playbook.
projects.what_it_does: Processes uploaded legal contracts, segments clauses, retrieves relevant reference clauses, analyzes risks, and explains findings with risk levels.

how_it_works.processing: Extracts contract text, segments clauses, retrieves relevant references from a legal clause playbook using RAG and ChromaDB, then uses an LLM for risk analysis.
outputs: Risk classifications: LOW, MEDIUM, HIGH, CRITICAL

visitor_interaction.how_visitor_starts: User opens ContractSentry and uploads a legal contract.
visitor_actions: Upload a legal contract
Review analyzed clauses
Review risk findings and explanations
system_response: Extracts contract text
Segments clauses
Retrieves reference clauses
Analyzes potential risks
Displays explanations and risk levels
visitor_interaction.completion: Interaction is complete when the contract risk findings, explanations, and risk levels are displayed.
